title: Swap Adjacent in LR String
description: Determine if start string can be transformed to result by swapping 'XL' to 'LX' or 'RX' to 'XR'.
pseudocode:
1. Filter non-X chars to compare sequence.
2. Use two pointers i, j to compare positions.
3. Check L/R movement constraints.

steps.note: Comparing non-X characters in start and result: 'RLRXRXL' vs 'RLRXRXL'. They match.
Start pointers at i=0, j=0. Found first non-X at i=0 (R), j=1 (R). Valid (i <= j for R).
Next non-X: i=3 (L), j=2 (L). Valid (i >= j for L).
Next non-X: i=4 (R), j=5 (R). Valid (i <= j for R).
Next non-X: i=6 (R), j=6 (R). Valid (i <= j for R).
Final non-X: i=8 (L), j=8 (L). All constraints satisfied. Return true.
